name: Blue Dodo 17
author: krlozCJ
description: Light blue button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, transform becomes translateY(5px), box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 0px 0px #a29bfe.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Blue Dodo 17</title>
<style>
/* Blue Dodo 17 by krlozCJ — https://uiverse.io/krlozCJ/blue-dodo-17 */
button {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  background-color: #6c5ce7;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 5px;
  transition: all ease 0.1s;
  box-shadow: 0px 5px 0px 0px #a29bfe;
}

button:active {
  transform: translateY(5px);
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px #a29bfe;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Click me
</button>

</body>
</html>
